responsibility: Declares the public target-specific interfaces implemented by the LM32 backend C file and referenced from the machine description or target macros. The prototypes cover ABI decisions such as returning aggregates in memory, prologue/epilogue expansion, operand and address printing, frame-elimination offsets, return handling, block move expansion, PIC address legitimization, conditional set/branch expansion, and move legality helpers, making this header the declaration bridge between lm32.cc, lm32.md, and target headers.
